name: Volatility-targeted sleeve (US)
perTradeNote: This book is an overlay on the stopped US parent: it holds the parent's stocks scaled to a volatility target, so it has no trades of its own; that kill line is not applied.
costNote: Scaling trades are charged 0.175% each way on the change in exposure (the middle US cost tier). US tiers are market costs and leave out your own brokerage and currency conversion.
